title: An unavailable recorded selection refuses instead of falling back
statement: With the recorded model removed from the registry, or its authentication absent, launch refuses and names the recorded provider and model, offering a setup rerun or an explicit one-run override. No other model, provider, or answer from model memory is substituted.
notes: ⚠️ NOT EVALUATED PENDING CI, 2026-09-22. EVD-0129 is the component proof; EVD-0132 measures the integrated launch path through the real command: a removed recorded model and absent authentication are each refused by name with both remedies and no supervisor started, a mismatched compatibility record is refused before anything starts, and nothing is substituted. Evaluated once CI passes on the wiring.
